description.value:
Requirement The target is willing or unconscious.

Cost 2 Vitae

Range touch

You get the ribs out of the way and work where the damage actually is.

The target regains Hit Points equal to 4 times your level, and one condition of your choice with a value — clumsy, drained, enfeebled or stupefied — is reduced by 2. Until the target next rests, its Hit Point maximum is reduced by your level; you closed it up in a hurry.

cinderfall.incomplete: This effect changes a different creature's own roll, HP, condition, or item, sourced from the card holder's own passive/item/action. No selector exists anywhere in pf2e-source for this -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass. for the heal/condition-reduction half. The temporary max-HP penalty as a drawback is additionally unhookable: no rule element applies a self-inflicted-by-the-caster, temporary max-HP penalty to a different creature as a side effect of healing it.
